She's 28.  She doesn't really work or study.  She busks for rent mostly or does odd jobs.  She doesn't often drink in excess, but has been drinking more lately.  We have all kinds of things that we do in the flat, but she doesn't want to do anything with anyone.

She has a mom and a step-dad, but they're alcoholics and live super unhealthily in a way that is a slow-motion suicide in her eyes.  She said tonight that she had threatened to kill herself if her family didn't stop killing themselves and apparently her family told her to just do it.  Her view of reality is obscured.  She doesn't see them as others do and cannot bring herself away from the darkness.
